newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet fuel diffs weaken in lackluster trade.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet fuel diffs weaken in lackluster trade.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel differentials weakened slightly Friday, though market players said activity was extremely thin.

"I think everybody's closed their books and headed to San Antonio," one trader said, referring to the absence of many players as they prepared to travel to National Petroleum Refiners Association convention which runs Sunday to Tuesday.

Prompt New York Harbor 54-grade jet barrels were offered between 4.00 and 4.25 cents over the screen, down about 0.30 cent, while prompt U.S. Gulf 54-grade was reported at about 1.50 cents over, traders said, down about 0.50 cent.
